title: Lamb Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with tender lamb and a rich, spicy curry sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add onion to pot.
Cook until onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry paste to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth to pot and bring to a simmer.
Return lamb to pot and cover with lid.
Transfer pot to preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes.
Stir in yogurt and lime juice.
Season with salt and warm spices to taste.
Serve lamb hot with sauce spooned over the top.
